Your Opportunity
We are seeking talented individuals to join our External Audit practise at KPMG.  We are open to full-time/part-time/casual/max-term/flexible working options.

IT External Audit
Our IT External Audit team assists our clients to meet their IT External audit requirements and timelines. We work as an integrated business and as part of a larger multi-disciplinary team. The team draws on a diverse and dedicated group of people, powerful KPMG methodologies, innovating capability and assets, and global resources to support our clients in achieving the right milestones. 

Audit & Assurance: External Audit
Our Audit teams provide value to our clients by delivering specialised quality audit and assurance services. High-quality, independent financial statement audits are essential to maintaining investor confidence. Our audit professionals are committed to the public interest, challenging assumptions, and unlocking valuable insights based on a solid understanding of an organisation’s business and industry.

How are you extraordinary?
•	You are analytically minded and enjoy applying structured thinking and analysis techniques to complex problems. 
•	You are a kind and compassionate leader with a passion for continually growing your leadership skills to get the best out of a diverse and multidisciplinary team.
•	You are a people-person with a love of sharing your Audit and Assurance insight and tailoring your communication appropriately for subject matter experts and clients who want to learn more.

Your Experience
To be considered for this opportunity, your qualifications, skills & experience could include:

IT External Audit
•	Experience in assisting clients meet their IT External audit requirements and timelines.
•	Supporting engagements in the preparation of clear and concise IT External Audit reports. 
•	Providing technical knowledge, direction, and training to engagement team members.
•	In a leadership role, manage small teams and oversee the planning and execution of IT External Audit client engagements
•	Supporting business proposals and business development activities by assisting in the identification of new target clients, building business relationships, and developing/presenting proposals/findings
•	An innovative mindset and passion for problem solving enabled through technology.

Audit & Assurance: External Audit
•	Experience leading, managing and executing advisory related engagements of high-profile clients and all aspects of audit delivery, client service and business development.
•	Providing technical knowledge, direction, and training to engagement team members.
•	Experience working across Private and Corporate clients is desired.
•	Qualifications in CA/CPA and CISA/CISM/CRISC, and strong IFRS skills, will be viewed favourably.

Please note, the salary ranges $60k - $100k+ with respect to your level of experience.

Royal Mechanical Group Pty Ltd, trading as Royal Poly Products, is a Perth-based Australian engineering and manufacturing company specialising in pipeline pigging and pipeline maintenance solutions for the oil & gas, mining, water, and infrastructure sectors.
We design and manufacture engineered pipeline pigs and support pipeline inspection and pigging operations through practical engineering, field experience, instrumentation support, and in-house R&D capabilities.


About the Role
We are seeking a motivated and technically capable Automation & Control Engineer to join our growing engineering team in Perth.
This role will focus on the design, integration, and optimisation of instrumentation, control systems, and data-driven technologies used in advanced pipeline pigging and inspection applications. You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams on smart inspection technologies, sensor integration, testing, and automation initiatives.
This is an exciting opportunity for an engineer looking to work on innovative products within a niche and highly specialised industry.


Key Responsibilities

Design and validate pipeline pig configurations using engineering calculations, MATLAB models, and performance analysis tools
Support development of instrumentation, monitoring, and data acquisition systems used in pipeline pigging and inspection operations
Assist in integration and evaluation of sensors, pig tracking instrumentation, and related pipeline monitoring technologies
Analyse pig performance, sealing efficiency, wear characteristics, and operational suitability across various pipeline conditions
Support testing, commissioning, and validation activities for pigging tools and associated instrumentation systems
Manage and maintain rental pig detection and tracking equipment, ensuring operational readiness and calibration compliance
Support development of pigging philosophies, operational procedures, and engineering recommendations for pipeline systems
Apply Python and/or MATLAB for engineering analysis, automation support, modelling, and data interpretation
Prepare technical reports, engineering documentation, validation records, and controlled revisions
Participate in research and development activities related to in-house smart pigging, automation, and pipeline inspection technologies
Collaborate with manufacturing, operations, and engineering teams to support product development and continuous improvement initiatives
Skills & Competencies

Strong understanding of instrumentation and control systems
Exposure to pipeline pig manufacturing industry and relevant instrumentation is essential
Analytical and problem-solving mindset
Understanding of data acquisition systems and sensor technologies
Ability to work independently and within multidisciplinary teams
Strong communication and technical documentation skills
Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechatronics, Instrumentation, Automation, or related discipline)
2–4 years of relevant engineering experience in pipeline pig manufacturing is preferred
Exposure to industrial automation, instrumentation, or embedded systems is advantageous
Preferred Tools & Systems

SolidWorks
Python and/or MATLAB
PLC/SCADA systems (desirable)
Why Join Us?

Work on cutting-edge pipeline inspection and automation technologies
Be part of a growing Australian engineering and manufacturing company
Exposure to international oil & gas and infrastructure projects
Opportunity to contribute directly to R&D and product innovation
Clear pathway toward technical leadership and advanced engineering roles

sales@royalmechgroup.com

result.description:
Location	Chatswood, NSW, 2067
Full-Time	Immediate start
Job Title	Advertising Specialist
Salary Range	$79,500 - $90,000 | depending on skills level and work experience + superannuation.
Job Closes Date	30 Days  

About the Client
On behalf of our client, a growing organization delivering integrated property, construction, and project management services, we are seeking an Advertising Specialist. This role is central to driving brand visibility and supporting sales objectives through strategic, data-informed campaigns.

Key Duties and Responsibilities
• Plan, develop, and manage advertising campaigns tailored to property and construction markets, ensuring alignment with sales objectives and project timelines.
• Advise senior management and external stakeholders on targeted advertising strategies to reach homebuyers, investors, and commercial clients, emphasizing property attributes and market positioning.
• Coordinate end-to-end campaign production, including artwork, copywriting, media scripting, and placement across digital, print, and broadcast channels, while adhering to budget and scheduling constraints.
• Commission and analyze market research to identify demand for new developments and existing property portfolios, using statistical data to refine pricing and sales strategies.
• Oversee digital marketing initiatives, including content creation, scheduling, and publishing across social media and websites, with a focus on driving engagement and lead generation.
• Monitor campaign performance through analytics tools, providing detailed reports and actionable insights to optimize ROI and adjust tactics in real time.
• Apply statistical modelling to evaluate the impact of pricing strategies on profitability, supporting competitive positioning in the property sector.
• Recommend and implement updates to website and digital content to improve search engine rankings and user experience.

Requirements
• 2+ years’ experience in advertising, marketing, or brand management, preferably in agriculture, food production, or premium consumer goods
• Demonstrated success developing campaigns that increased market share for premium products
• Exceptional ability to translate technical agricultural information into compelling consumer messaging
• Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting market research and sales data
• Proficiency with digital marketing tools, CRM platforms, and analytics software
• Outstanding project management capabilities with experience managing budgets and timelines
• Degree in Marketing, Communications, Agricultural Business, or related field.

How to Apply: 
Submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and interest in agricultural mechanical systems.

Please note: We are acting as recruitment agents on behalf of our client. Employer details will be provided to shortlisted candidates.
